messages.subject_clean: [rkward-users] [Help] RE: Use R console on a via SSH con. Remote PC
messages.body_plain:
The following forum message was posted by tfry at http://sourceforge.net/projects/rkward/forums/forum/165574/topic/4985957:

Hi!

This is not currently possible, but we do intend to support this, eventually.
However this does mean a good bit of development effort, and we're always short
on time. Thus, please don't hold your breath.

As an interim solution, you may want to consider running RKWard on the remote
server, using a VNC or remote X11 connection tunnelled through SSH.

Regards
Thomas

The following forum message was posted by stimpy-ch at http://sourceforge.net/projects/rkward/forums/forum/165573/topic/5071200:

Hi,

I have installed rkward from Ubuntu repository. 
My specs:
OS: Kubuntu 11.10, 64bit
R: v2.14.1
rkward: 0.5.6

When I run rkward an error message comes up reporting about a communication
problem with R. Later it says this error is not further specified.

In details you can see
[i]R version 2.14.1 (2011-12-22)
Copyright (C) 2011 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing
ISBN 3-900051-07-0
Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (64-bit)

R ist freie Software und kommt OHNE JEGLICHE GARANTIE.
Sie sind eingeladen, es unter bestimmten Bedingungen weiter zu verbreiten.
Tippen Sie 'license()' or 'licence()' f?r Details dazu.

R ist ein Gemeinschaftsprojekt mit vielen Beitragenden.
Tippen Sie 'contributors()' f?r mehr Information und 'citation()',
um zu erfahren, wie R oder R packages in Publikationen zitiert werden k?nnen.

Tippen Sie 'demo()' f?r einige Demos, 'help()' f?r on-line Hilfe, oder
'help.start()' f?r eine HTML Browserschnittstelle zur Hilfe.
Tippen Sie 'q()', um R zu verlassen.


[b]Attache Paket: ?rkward?

The following object(s) are masked from ?package:grDevices?:

x11, X11

The following object(s) are masked from ?package:base?:

makeActiveBinding, q, quit, require, setwd, Sys.setlocale

Fehler in assign(backupname, original, envir = as.environment("package:rkward"))
:
kann keine Bindungen zu einer abgeschlossenen Umgebung hinzuf?gen
Calls: .rk.fix.assignments -> rk.replace.function -> assign
starting httpd help server ... done
Fehler in assign(".rk.output.html.file", x, as.environment("package:rkward"))
:
kann den Wert einer festgestellten Bindung f?r '.rk.output.html.file' nicht
?ndern
Calls: rk.set.output.html.file -> assign[/b][/i]

If I try to run a script file like downloading sme file (file <- "http://.....
) im getting a message like (freely translated)
Error in .rk.set.reply(NULL) : 
  unable to change value of a given bounding for '.rk.rkreply' 
Calls: <Anonymous> -> .rk.do.call -> .rk.set.reply

What is there going wrong?

King regards 
stimpy-ch

messages.body_plain:
The following forum message was posted by tfry at http://sourceforge.net/projects/rkward/forums/forum/165573/topic/5071200:

Hi!

You are using R from CRAN or from a PPA. Often this will work with the version
of RKWard in the main Ubuntu archive. In the case of R 2.14.x it does not. Please
install rkward (version 0.5.7) from this PPA, instead:
[url]https://launchpad.net/~rkward-devel/+archive/rkward-stable-cran[/url] .

Regards
Thomas
